title: El Estero Boating

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Come see us today - our friendly staff is ready to help with anything you may need! Our Paddle Boat Fleet on Lake El Estero consists of well-maintained fiberglass boats. Children and adults of all ages can ride them. Young children must be accompanied by an adult. We accept Visa and Mastercard. Ask about special rates for group events and birthday parties!​ Boat capacity is 5 people per boat with a 4 adult per boat maximum.Max capacity:
